$comment: UI bus. clicks: a switch click whenever one of the watched snapshot paths changes value (SAS, RCS, lights, gear, fine control, navball mode, warp, target). alarm: the master caution-and-warning tone, a procedurally rendered two-tone pattern looped while any condition holds (at least minDuration seconds per trigger; a cleared condition re-arms after rearm seconds). Condition fields: path into the snapshot, then one of above / below / equals; `relativeTo` divides the value by another path first.
